title: Structure-Preserving Neural Approximation of Convex, Semiconvex, and Quasiconvex Functions
abstract: arXiv:2611.24325v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Input convex neural networks provide a natural way to enforce convexity globally through architectural constraints. We study how this structure-preserving approximation framework extends to semiconvex, quasiconvex, and convex transformable functions. For $C^{1,1}$ convex functions on compact convex domains, we establish the sharp $W^{1,p}$ minimax rate $m^{-1/d}$ under max-affine approximation with $m$ affine pieces, and show that every max-affine function admits an exact bounded-width ICNN representation with complexity linear in $m$. The same $W^{1,p}$ approximation rate extends to semiconvex functions through quadratic lifting and to convex transformable functions through monotone composition. For general Lipschitz quasiconvex functions, we develop a quantitative finite-probe approximation theory based on monotone responses to affine projections and obtain a structure-preserving IqCNN with an $L^\infty$ approximation guarantee. translated_title: 凸函数、半凸函数与拟凸函数的结构保持神经逼近
translated_abstract: 输入凸神经网络通过架构约束提供了一种在全局范围内强制凸性的自然方法。我们研究了这种结构保持逼近框架如何扩展到半凸函数、拟凸函数以及凸可变换函数。对于紧凸域上的 $C^{1,1}$ 凸函数，我们在使用 $m$ 个仿射分片的最大仿射逼近下建立了尖锐的 $W^{1,p}$ 极小极大速率 $m^{-1/d}$，并证明每个最大仿射函数都存在精确的有界宽度 ICNN 表示，其复杂度与 $m$ 呈线性关系。同样的 $W^{1,p}$ 逼近速率通过二次提升扩展到了半凸函数，并通过单调复合扩展到了凸可变换函数。对于一般的 Lipschitz 拟凸函数，我们基于对仿射投影的单调响应发展了一种定量的有限探测逼近理论，并得到了具有 $L^\infty$ 逼近保证的结构保持 IqCNN。（注：原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文将输入凸神经网络的结构保持逼近框架扩展到半凸、拟凸和凸可变换函数，建立了尖锐的极小极大逼近速率，并发展了具有 $L^\infty$ 逼近保证的结构保持输入拟凸神经网络（IqCNN）。
en_tdlr: This paper extends the structure-preserving approximation framework of input convex neural networks to semiconvex, quasiconvex, and convex transformable functions, establishes sharp minimax approximation rates, and develops a structure-preserving IqCNN with $L^\infty$ approximation guarantees.
